title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 DNSSEC Policy Work Item
summary: Add deterministic local DNSSEC policy for RFC 9463 ADN-only SVCB resolution.
planned_changes:
- Add DNSSEC validation status and ADN-only SVCB resolution status value types.
- Add a pure policy helper that accepts only secure DNSSEC validation for ADN-only SVCB-derived resolver parameters.
- Reject insecure, bogus, indeterminate, and missing DNSSEC validation outcomes.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge tests plus canonical xrefs.
- Update the encrypted DNS gap ledger to remove local DNSSEC policy modeling from the open future-work set.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused DNSSEC policy tests, core SpecTrace validation, generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: Live DNSSEC validation and DNSSEC chain construction.
completion_notes: The DNS package now has a trace-owned local DNSSEC policy floor for ADN-only SVCB resolution.
